tools.name: search_titles
tools.description: Search the Vooks library of animated read-along storybooks, audiobooks and ebooks for children. Combine a free-text query with a child's age, a topic, a narration language and whether an audio-only version exists. Use this to answer 'what should a five-year-old who likes dinosaurs watch'. Returns the matching titles and the true total for the filters, so you can tell a narrow result from an empty library.

age.description: A child's age in whole years. Matches titles whose published range contains it.

audio_only_available.description: True to return only titles that also play audio-only, for screen-free listening.

limit.description: How many titles to return, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

query.description: Free text matched against title, author, illustrator, summary and topics.

topic.description: A topic slug from list_topics, for example animals or counting.

tools.name: get_title
tools.description: Fetch a single Vooks title by its slug, including the publisher's full description, age band, Lexile measure, running time and topics. Reads the live catalog rather than the search index, so it is never a snapshot. Use it after search_titles when you need to say more about one book than the search result carries.

slug.description: The title's slug, as returned by search_titles, for example 10-little-fish.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List every topic slug search_titles accepts, with how many titles carry each one. Call this before filtering by topic rather than guessing a slug: a guess that does not exist is rejected, and this tells you what the library is actually organised around.

contains.description: Only return topics whose slug contains this text.

tools.name: recommend_titles
tools.description: Pick Vooks titles for one child, given their age, what they are interested in, how many minutes are available and which language to narrate in. Each recommendation comes back with the reason it was chosen, so you can explain the pick to a parent or teacher rather than just listing books.

age.description: The child's age in whole years.

interests.description: What the child likes, in plain words, for example ["dinosaurs", "kindness"].

limit.description: How many to recommend. Defaults to 5.

max_minutes.description: Longest acceptable running time in minutes. Titles longer than this are excluded.

tools.name: get_pricing_plans
tools.description: Return every published Vooks subscription plan with its price, billing interval, audience and free-trial length, plus the school and district option, which is quoted per customer rather than priced. Use this to answer what Vooks costs instead of quoting a figure from memory.

audience.description: Only return plans for this audience. Omit to get them all.

tools.name: create_catalog_export
tools.description: Start an asynchronous export of every Vooks title matching the given filters, for bulk work that would otherwise be hundreds of searches. Returns a job id immediately; poll it with get_export_job. The idempotency_key makes a retry safe: calling again with the same key returns the original job rather than starting a second one.

age.description: Only export titles published for this age.

idempotency_key.description: A key you choose, 8 to 200 characters. Reusing it returns the job it started instead of creating another.

language.description: Only export titles in this narration language.

topic.description: Only export titles carrying this topic.

tools.name: get_export_job
tools.description: Report the status of an export started by create_catalog_export. download_url points at the finished export. A job is derived from its id rather than stored, so it never expires and needs no polling: the status is succeeded the moment create_catalog_export returns.

job_id.description: The job id returned by create_catalog_export.
